item.title: ‘Might is right’ world especially damaging for small states like Malta, Myriam Spiteri Debono says
item.description: President Myriam Spiteri Debono tells diplomatic corps she supports two-state solution in the Middle East and called for genuine efforts to end Russia’s ‘illegal and unprovoked’ war against Ukraine in line with international law • President describes climate change as an existential threat for small island states

item.title: [WATCH] Malta Eurovision Song Contest 2026 begins tonight with semi-final
item.description: Culture minister Owen Bonnici says backstage workers are ‘truly dedicated’ as country begins search for Vienna representative

item.title: The growth of online bingo sites in the UK
item.description: From community halls to smartphone apps, bingo has reinvented itself for the digital age, with mobile play, social features and strong regulation driving rapid growth across the UK

item.title: Man accused of raping and threatening sex worker at his Żabbar residence
item.description: The alleged victim, who is due to return to Colombia, gave urgent testimony via videolink describing threats, unlawful detention and non-consensual sex at the accused’s Żabbar home

item.title: Court rules lifer ‘is-Sufu’ entitled to parole review, urges legislative reform
item.description: Constitutional court says Malta’s parole law still fails life prisoners as it orders parole eligibility clock to start from 2013 sentence

item.title: Man charged with raping woman he met from Tinder
item.description: Accused’s wife learnt her husband had been accused of raping another woman he met on Tinder as charges were being read in court

item.title: Man fined €15,000 and banned for life from keeping animals over neglect of dogs
item.description: The court found the dogs were kept without proper food, water or shelter, suffering from parasites and illness, and ruled the neglect serious enough to warrant a lifetime ban

item.title: Two granted bail over New Year’s Day bar brawl that left two men seriously injured
item.description: CCTV footage allegedly shows the accused entering the bar carrying an iron bar, but the court said remaining witnesses were unlikely to change the evidential picture and imposed curfews, daily reporting and protection orders instead of remand

item.title: Woman seriously injured after car crashes into wall in Swieqi
item.description: The 70-year-old driver was taken to Mater Dei Hospital after losing control of her vehicle in Triq Sant’Andrija on Thursday afternoon

item.title: PN appoints new party officials following executive committee elections
item.description: Charles Bonello was named secretary general as the Nationalist Party filled seven key posts for the next two years during a vote by its executive committee
